what: DiLoCo across 4 separate GitHub-hosted runners, 3 rounds x 100 inner steps, int8 deltas as artifacts; Osirus native model (3.28M parameters, byte-level), enwik8
reading: Proof of mechanism, not of quality: 4 machines that never talk directly train one model; validation loss falls every round; each worker sends 3.3 MB (int8) per round instead of 13.1 MB fp32 per step. Quality against synchronous training is test T1.
